title: Direwolf APRS Gate Delay by Port
dataSources: FT8 spots (`ft8:spot`), JS8Call messages (`js8call:message`), PSKReporter receptions (`pskreporter:spot`), Direwolf TNC telemetry (`direwolf:packet`), and NOAA APT pass events (`noaaapt:pass`).
app: Weak-signal and decoder telemetry from WSJT-X FT8, JS8Call, PSKReporter, Direwolf TNC, NOAA APT pass schedulers, and station-control scripts sent to Splunk HEC via APIs, ADIF/log exports, and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=direwolf:packet
| search gate_delay_sec=*
| stats avg(gate_delay_sec) as avg_gate_delay_sec perc90(gate_delay_sec) as p90_gate_delay_sec count as samples by tnc_port
| sort 0 - avg_gate_delay_sec
description: Measures Direwolf packet-to-gate delay by TNC port.
value: Packet-to-gate latency helps separate RF trouble from local TNC or relay bottlenecks.
implementation: Send the relevant duration field for Direwolf packet-to-gate delay to `index=personal` and review both average and p90 latency instead of relying on single examples.
visualization: Table of average and p90 Direwolf packet-to-gate delay.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals how long Direwolf packet-to-gate delay usually takes, so slowdowns are obvious instead of anecdotal.
